content.short: A decentralized GPU cloud platform providing scalable computing power for AI, cloud gaming, and enterprises.
content.description:
Aethir is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) and GPU cloud platform built for AI, cloud gaming, and enterprise applications. By aggregating independent GPU providers into a global pool, Aethir reduces costs and hardware waste. The network features a robust verification system with over 91,000 Checker Nodes that monitor and ensure the highest service quality.

Utilizing edge computing, Aethir delivers low-latency real-time rendering and AI inference. The ATH token powers the ecosystem, used for purchasing compute capacity and rewarding node operators.
